example.en: Employees may reach their regional sales coordinators directly via work cell phone numbers.
example.zh: 員工可透過公務手機號碼直接聯絡其區域業務協調員。

words.mnemonic: 通訊工具核心字：cell phone (手機)。

example.en: A prominent trade publication recently featured an insightful article about our green technology.
example.zh: 一家知名行業出版物最近刊登了一篇深入報導我們綠色環保科技的專文。

words.mnemonic: 媒體報導與公文物品：magazine article (雜誌專文)、articles of agreement (合約條款)。

example.en: Our express courier guarantees fast and reliable nationwide parcel delivery within two business days.
example.zh: 我們的快捷快遞保證在兩個工作天內提供快速可靠的全國包裹送達服務。

words.mnemonic: 物流效率標籤：fast delivery (快速送達)、fast track (快速通道)。

example.en: The corporate cybersecurity division successfully blocked a malicious cyber attack on our server.
example.zh: 企業網路安全部門成功攔截阻擋了一起針對我們伺服器的惡意網路攻擊。

words.mnemonic: 現代資訊科技多益大考點：cyber attack (網路資安攻擊)。

example.en: International business analysts monitored sudden fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates.
example.zh: 國際商務分析師密切關注外國貨幣匯率的突然波動。

words.mnemonic: 跨國貿易考點：foreign currency (外幣)、foreign investment (外國投資)。

example.en: The management team arranged a surprise retirement celebration banquet for the chief engineer.
example.zh: 管理團隊為主任總工程師籌辦了一場驚喜退休慶祝晚宴。

words.mnemonic: 職場社交動態：surprise party (驚喜派對)、come as a surprise (令人感到意外)。

example.en: The updated smartphone application features an intuitive and streamlined user interface design.
example.zh: 這款更新後的智慧型手機應用程式以直覺且簡約的用戶介面設計為主要特色。

words.mnemonic: 產品規格文宣核心字：safety features (安全配備)、key feature (主要特點)。

example.en: Reliable customer technical service was cited as a major decisive factor in renewing the software contract.
example.zh: 可靠的客戶技術支援服務被列為續訂軟體合約的主要決定性因素。

words.mnemonic: 商業分析常用詞：deciding factor (決定性因素)、key factor (關鍵因素)。
words.roots: fact 做 → 促成結果的因素

example.en: Initial sales figures for our recently launched consumer electronics line were pretty impressive.
example.zh: 我們最近上市的消費性電子產品線初期銷售數據相當令人印象深刻。

words.mnemonic: 口語聽力程度修飾副詞：pretty good (相當不錯)。

example.en: The corporate executive committee recently appointed an experienced logistics consultant.
example.zh: 企業執行委員會最近聘任了一位經驗豐富的物流管理顧問。

words.mnemonic: 時態關鍵時間副詞：通常搭配現在完成式或過去式。

example.en: Severe winter weather disruptions could adversely affect international cargo delivery schedules.
example.zh: 嚴冬惡劣天候的中斷可能會對國際貨運航班的遞送時程產生不利影響。

words.mnemonic: 及物動詞 affect = have an effect on (影響)。

example.en: Wholesale raw material prices are projected to drop by five percent over the next quarter.
example.zh: 預計批發原料價格將在下一季度下跌百分之五。

words.mnemonic: 數值下降與快遞投遞：drop in price (價格下跌)、drop off (順道放下/投遞)。

example.en: According to a recent market survey, consumers increasingly prioritize sustainable product packaging.
example.zh: 根據最近的一份市場調查報告，消費者日益重視環保永續的產品包裝。

words.mnemonic: 調查與新聞標誌詞：recent survey (近期的調查)、recent years (近年來)。

example.en: The seminar agenda covers several critical topics related to international environmental compliance.
example.zh: 研討會議程涵蓋了數個與國際環保法規遵從密切相關的關鍵主題。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀必考分詞片語：related to (與...相關)。
roots: lat 攜帶 → 帶回關聯

example.en: All employees will receive an official written statement outlining the revised holiday schedule.
example.zh: 所有員工都將收到一份概述修訂後連假休假行事曆的正式書面公告。

words.mnemonic: 正式文件核心形容詞：official announcement (官方公告)、official website (官方網站)。

example.en: The corporate treasurer presented the annual audited financial report to international investors.
example.zh: 企業財務主管向國際投資人呈報了經審計的年度財務報告。

words.mnemonic: 多益最重要主題詞：financial statement (財務報表)、financial analyst (財務分析師)。

example.en: Passengers who miss their connecting flight will be automatically rebooked on the next departure.
example.zh: 錯過轉機航班的旅客將會被自動重新改訂安排在下一班起飛班機上。

words.mnemonic: 錯過班機或截止日：miss a flight (錯過班機)、miss a deadline (錯過截止日)。

meaning: 先進工藝(state of the art)

example.en: Our newly constructed manufacturing plant is equipped with state of the art robotic assembly tools.
example.zh: 我們新建的製造廠房配備了最先進的機器人自動組裝工具。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業超級高頻考點：state of the art (最先進的/頂尖的)。

example.en: The marketing department launched an aggressive advertising campaign across national digital channels.
example.zh: 行銷部在全國各大數位傳播通路上發動了一場強勁的廣告促銷活動。

words.mnemonic: 商業行銷必背名詞：advertising campaign (廣告宣傳活動)、marketing campaign (行銷專案)。

example.en: Executive directors conducted their confidential contract negotiations in a private conference suite.
example.zh: 執行董事們在獨立私密的高階主管會議套房中進行了機密合約談判。

words.mnemonic: 公私部門對比：private sector (民營部門/私營企業)、private office (獨立私人辦公室)。
words.roots: priv 分開、個人 + -ate 形容詞

example.en: Factory technicians decided to pause the assembly line briefly to replace a worn drive belt.
example.zh: 工廠技術人員決定短暫暫停組裝流水線，以更換磨損的傳動皮帶。

words.mnemonic: 暫停中斷動詞：pause the video (暫停影片)、pause production (暫停生產)。

example.en: Everyone in the office is cordially invited to attend the annual employee recognition reception.
example.zh: 誠摯邀請辦公室的全體同仁出席年度優秀員工表揚茶會。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：everyone 作主詞時，動詞一律接「單數動詞」！

example.en: Please do not forget to submit your signed timesheet to the payroll department by Friday noon.
example.zh: 請不要忘記在週五中午前將您簽名確認的出勤工時表繳交至薪資核算部。

words.mnemonic: 備忘提醒句型：Don't forget to do (別忘了做某事)。

example.en: Clients can browse our full product catalog and request price quotes on our home page.
example.zh: 客戶可在我們的官方網站首頁上瀏覽完整產品目錄並索取報價。

words.mnemonic: 網路行銷與機場廣播：home page (首頁)、page a passenger (在機場廣播呼叫旅客)。

example.en: Do not worry if your original receipt is misplaced; our customer care team can look up the order.
example.zh: 若您的原始收據遺失請無需擔心，我們的客服關懷團隊可直接替您查詢該筆訂單。

words.mnemonic: 安撫客戶情緒常用句型：Don't worry about (不用擔心...)。

example.en: The corporate marketing department welcomes ten university interns during our annual summer program.
example.zh: 企業行銷部在我們的年度暑期實習計畫中熱烈歡迎十名大學生實習生。

words.mnemonic: 季節性招募與促銷：summer internship (暑期實習)、summer sale (夏季特賣)。

example.en: Complimentary cold drinks and light snacks will be served during the afternoon seminar break.
example.zh: 下午研討會茶歇期間將供應免費冰飲與精緻點心。

words.mnemonic: 招待餐飲詞彙：complimentary drink (免費招待飲料)、soft drink (無酒精汽水)。

example.en: We highly value your opinion and invite you to complete our brief customer feedback survey.
example.zh: 我們非常重視您的寶貴意見，並竭誠邀請您填寫我們簡短的客戶回饋問卷。

words.mnemonic: 問卷與會議表達：in my opinion (依我之見)、ask for an opinion (徵詢意見)。

example.en: Our new corporate technology headquarters is situated inside a modern green business park.
example.zh: 我們全新的企業科技總部座落於一座現代化的綠色商業園區內。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：business park / office park (商辦園區)；動詞 park a car (停車)。

example.en: Ms. Tanaka was selected to represent our regional marketing division at the Tokyo software summit.
example.zh: 田中女士獲選代表我們的區域行銷部門出席東京軟體高峰會。

words.mnemonic: 商業代表與發言：represent the company (代表公司)；衍生 sales representative (業務代表)。

example.en: Fostering client trust is the key factor that drives our corporate commercial expansion.
example.zh: 培養客戶信任是推動我們企業商務擴張的關鍵核心要素。

words.mnemonic: 簡報重點形容詞：key factor (關鍵因素)、keynote speaker (主講嘉賓)。

example.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside all corporate office complexes and manufacturing facilities.
example.zh: 所有企業辦公園區與生產廠房設施內部一律嚴格禁止吸菸。

words.mnemonic: 場所指示介系詞：inside the building (大樓內部)。

example.en: Our marketing delegation will attend the upcoming international software trade conference in Berlin.
example.zh: 我們的行銷代表團將參加即將在柏林舉行的國際軟體貿易大會。

words.mnemonic: 字首 inter- 表「在...之間」，搭配 national 即國際間的。

example.en: The attached electronic spreadsheet contains detailed expenditure records for the second quarter.
example.zh: 隨附的電子試算表內含有第二季度的詳細支出紀錄。

words.mnemonic: 檔案與貨品內容描述動詞；名詞 container (貨櫃/容器)。

example.en: I was wondering if the corporate accounting department has approved our travel reimbursement claim.
example.zh: 我想了解一下企業會計部門是否已經核准了我們的差旅報銷申請。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信客氣詢問開頭：I was wondering if... (不知是否能...)。

example.en: Due to the sensitive confidential nature of the project, all team members must sign non-disclosure agreements.
example.zh: 鑑於該專案敏感的保密性質，所有團隊成員皆必須簽署保密協定。

words.mnemonic: 多益正式商務公文搭配：by its nature (本質上)、confidential nature (機密性質)。

example.en: The executive board introduced a new organizational management structure to accelerate decision-making.
example.zh: 執行董事會推出了一項新的組織管理架構，以加速決策進行。

words.mnemonic: 公司組織與費率名詞：organizational structure (組織架構)、fee structure (收費結構)。

example.en: Please refer to the technical specifications section on page twelve of the user manual.
example.zh: 請參閱使用手冊第十二頁的技術規格區塊。

words.mnemonic: 文件與區域劃分詞彙：non-smoking section (禁菸區)、cross-section (橫切面)。

example.en: I will inspect the newly renovated corporate conference facility myself before the annual meeting.
example.zh: 在年度大會之前，我將親自視察全新裝修的企業會議設施。

words.mnemonic: 主詞強調用法：by myself (獨自)、see for myself (親自去看看)。

example.en: The invoice amount must match the approved purchase order estimate exactly before payment processing.
example.zh: 發票金額在撥款前必須與核准的採購訂單估算完全精準吻合。

words.mnemonic: 精確性副詞：not exactly (不完全是)、exactly what we need (正是我們需要的)。

example.en: The international flight from Tokyo is scheduled to arrive at terminal two on time.
example.zh: 來自東京的國際班機預定準時抵達第二航廈。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通準點高頻搭配：arrive on time (準時抵達)、arrive at the airport (抵達機場)。

example.en: Customer care representatives should remain patient and polite when addressing billing complaints.
example.zh: 客戶關懷專員在處理帳單申訴時應始終保持耐心與禮貌。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服品質形容詞：be patient with (對...有耐心)。

example.en: Under current company financial guidelines, travel entertainment expenditures require prior approval.
example.zh: 依據目前的企業財務規範，差旅應酬支出皆需事先報准。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 當前狀態指標詞：current position (現職)、current market conditions (當前市場行情)。

example.en: The manufacturing enterprise celebrated over a century of precision engineering innovation.
example.zh: 該製造企業慶祝了其在精密工程創新領域走過一個多世紀的輝煌歷程。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 百年老店品牌宣傳常用：over a century of excellence (百年卓越)。

example.en: The audit committee found clear documentary evidence of accounting compliance across all subsidiaries.
example.zh: 審計委員會在所有子公司中皆發現了符合會計合規規範的明確文件證據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 不可數名詞大考點：clear evidence (明確證據)、evidence to support (支持...的證據)。
roots: vid 看 → 看得出來的證據

example.en: Strict regulatory safeguards exist to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive client databases.
example.zh: 現行制度中存在著嚴格的監管防護機制，以防止敏感客戶資料庫遭到未授權存取。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 存在動詞，衍生名詞 existence (存在)、形容詞 existing (現有的)。
roots: sist 站 → 站出來存在

example.en: Our new smartphone model delivers performance features similar to those of competitor devices.
example.zh: 我們的新款智慧型手機機型提供與競爭對手機型相仿的性能特點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 比較規格必考片語：similar to (與...相似)。

example.en: Retail businesses must fight aggressively to maintain their market presence against online competitors.
example.zh: 實體零售商家必須積極奮戰，以對抗線上競爭對手並保住市場份額。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 市場抗衡比喻用語：fight for market share (爭奪市占率)。

example.en: Our enterprise is recognized as a global industry leader in renewable clean energy technology.
example.zh: 我們企業獲公認為全球再生乾淨能源科技領域的產業龍頭。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業地位經典搭配：industry leader (產業龍頭)、market leader (市場領導者)。

example.en: Drivers who fail to display a valid parking permit will be subject to a fifty-dollar fine.
example.zh: 未出示有效停車許可證的駕駛將會被處以五十美元的罰款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：名詞「罰款」pay a fine；形容詞「精細的」fine print (合約細則小字)。

example.en: Our flagship retail store is centrally located across the street from the subway station.
example.zh: 我們的旗艦零售門市位於捷運站正對面的街角黃金地段。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 地址方位必備：across the street (在街對面)、on the street (在街上)。

example.en: The keynote address was delivered by the former president of the national trade association.
example.zh: 開幕主題演講由前任全國商貿協會會長親自發表。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人事異動與履歷常見：former employee (前任員工)、the former (前者)。

example.en: Please do not hesitate to contact our customer support team if you require additional information.
example.zh: 若您需要進一步資訊，請隨時與我們的客戶支援團隊聯繫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益書信結尾最標準動詞：contact us (與我們聯絡)、contact person (聯絡窗口)。

example.en: The new ergonomic office chairs are particularly comfortable during long working hours.
example.zh: 這款全新人體工學辦公椅在長時間工作期間格外舒適耐坐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 程度副詞，強調特定優點：particularly useful (格外有用)。

example.en: Corporate employees may extend healthcare insurance coverage to their husband or wife.
example.zh: 企業員工得將其醫療健康保險保障範圍擴大涵蓋其配偶夫或妻。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工家庭福利條款常見詞彙：spouse (配偶) 或 husband and wife。

example.en: The corporate employee recreation club sponsors annual amateur sport leagues for staff members.
example.zh: 企業員工育樂社團每年為同仁資助籌辦業餘體育聯賽。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 休閒福利與零售：sporting goods (體育用品)、sports club (體育俱樂部)。

example.en: Department heads will meet tomorrow morning to discuss the quarterly expenditure budget.
example.zh: 部門主管將於明天上午會面以商討季度支出預算。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 及物動詞，後面直接接受詞！千萬不要加 about (discuss the plan)。
roots: cuss 搖、敲 → 拆開討論

example.en: Our support center guarantees an email response within twenty-four hours of receiving an inquiry.
example.zh: 我們的客服支援中心保證在收到洽詢後的二十四小時內給予電子郵件答覆。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公文必考搭配：in response to (為了回應...)、quick response (快速回覆)。

example.en: Please leave a detailed message on my corporate voicemail if I am away from my desk.
example.zh: 若我不在辦公座位前，請在我的企業語音信箱中留下詳細留言。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室通訊必考字：voicemail (語音信箱)、voice mail message (語音留言)。

example.en: The facility manager ordered several new pieces of ergonomic office equipment for staff.
example.zh: 廠房主管為員工訂購了數件全新的人體工學辦公設備器材。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 量詞大考點：a piece of advice (一則建議)、a piece of equipment (一件設備)。

example.en: The engineering team worked overtime to finish the software upgrade ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 工程團隊加班趕工以提前完成軟體系統升級作業。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工作完工動詞，後接名詞或 V-ing：finish doing something。

example.en: All employees are supposed to wear their photo identification badges inside the building.
example.zh: 所有員工在大樓內部均應當配戴其照片身分識別證。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場規章必考句型：be supposed to + 原形動詞 (理應/應該要)。
roots: pos 放置 → 放在下面假設

example.en: Interested candidates should apply online before the official submission deadline on Friday.
example.zh: 有興趣的應徵者應在週五官方截止日期前完成線上求職申請。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益兩大王牌搭配：apply for a job (應徵工作)、apply to (適用於)。
roots: ply 折、貼 → 貼向、申請

example.en: The company president delivered an inspiring opening address at the annual trade summit.
example.zh: 公司總裁在年度商貿高峰會上發表了鼓舞人心的開幕致詞。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 高階管理層職稱：vice president (副總裁/副總)、company president (公司總裁)。

example.en: All factory workers must participate in the mandatory building fire safety evacuation drill.
example.zh: 所有工廠員工皆必須參與大樓強制性的消防安全疏散演習。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工安演習名詞：fire drill (消防演習)、fire alarm (火災警報器)。

example.en: Corporate sales increased by eighteen percent compared to the same period last year.
example.zh: 企業銷售額與去年同期相比增長了百分之十八。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財報最常考分詞片語：compared to / compared with (與...相比)。
roots: par 相等 → 放一起比

example.en: Shopping mall visitors can enjoy a wide variety of meals in the third-floor food court.
example.zh: 購物中心訪客可在三樓美食街享用各式各樣的餐飲美食。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商場與商務情境常客：food court (美食街)、take to court (提告)。

example.en: Airport police officers patrol passenger terminal concourses around the clock for safety.
example.zh: 機場警官全天候在客運航廈大廳巡邏以確保旅客安全。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 維安保全用語：police officer (警官)、police department (警察局)。

example.en: Our new flagship department store will open its doors to retail shoppers next Friday.
example.zh: 我們全新的旗艦百貨門市將於下週五正式開門迎接零售購物顧客。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重用法：名詞「零售店」retail store；動詞「存放資料」store data。

example.en: The manufacturing plant replaced the aging conveyor belt due to poor operational efficiency.
example.zh: 由於運作效率低落不佳，製造廠更換了老化的輸送帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 品質評估反面詞：poor quality (劣質)、poor condition (狀況不佳)。

example.en: The technical support position requires sound practical knowledge of cloud networking systems.
example.zh: 該技術支援職位需要具備紮實的雲端網路系統實務知識。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 履歷要求詞彙：working knowledge of (對...具備實務知識)。

example.en: The motivational speaker shared humorous industry anecdotes that made the audience laugh.
example.zh: 激勵演講大師分享了幽默的產業趣聞，引得現場觀眾開懷大笑。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 社交會場氣氛描寫詞：make people laugh (引人發笑)。

example.en: Factory operators upgraded the robotic welding arm to improve manufacturing precision.
example.zh: 工廠作業員升級了自動化機械焊接手臂以提高製造精度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工廠自動化與家具配件：robotic arm (機械手臂)、armchair (單人扶手椅)。

example.en: Our boutique corporate hotel is conveniently situated in the very heart of the financial district.
example.zh: 我們的精品商務飯店坐落於金融商業區最繁華的正中心核心地帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 地理位置黃金片語：in the heart of (在...的正中心)。

example.en: Our restaurant chain partners with certified organic farms to source fresh culinary ingredients.
example.zh: 我們的連鎖餐廳與合格有機農場合作，以採購新鮮的烹飪食材原料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 採購與能源來源：source of revenue (營收來源)、renewable energy source (再生能源)。

example.en: Every employee receives an identification card.
example.zh: 每位員工都有一張識別證。

reviewWords.mnemonic: employ 的人。

example.en: The senior project director will manage cross-departmental coordination for the new rollout.
example.zh: 資深專案總監將主導管理新產品推展的跨部門協調工作。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 管理核心動詞：manage a project (管理專案)、manage to do (設法辦成)。

example.en: To subscribe to our monthly newsletter, simply enter your email address into our web portal.
example.zh: 欲訂閱我們的每月電子通訊刊物，只需在我們的網站入口輸入您的電子郵件地址即可。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 促銷操作指示句首詞：Simply call / Simply visit (只需致電/只需造訪)。

example.en: Clients can settle corporate consulting invoices via electronic commercial bank transfers.
example.zh: 客戶可透過電子商業銀行轉帳方式結清企業顧問諮詢費發票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 金融機構必考：bank account (銀行帳戶)、bank statement (對帳單)。

example.en: Our international consulting firm specializes in cross-border corporate mergers and acquisitions.
example.zh: 我們的國際顧問事務所專門提供跨國企業併購與重組顧問服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 專業機構常用名詞：law firm (律師事務所)、accounting firm (會計師事務所)。

example.en: The boutique waterfront hotel provided a very nice atmosphere for the annual networking gala.
example.zh: 這間濱水精品飯店為年度人脈交流晚會提供了非常舒適美好的氛圍。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 評價環境或待人親切常用詞：have a nice stay (祝您住宿愉快)。

example.en: The invoice clearly states the total amount due including applicable shipping and handling fees.
example.zh: 發票上明確載明了應付總金額，包含適用的運費與處理費。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 修飾不可數名詞或款項：amount of money (金額)、total amount (總額)。

example.en: High-resolution pictures of our latest product line are available in the online press kit.
example.zh: 我們最新產品線的高解析度照片已備置於線上媒體新聞發布資料包中。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行銷圖片與總體情勢：take a picture (拍照)、the big picture (整體大局)。

example.en: The sporting goods company launched an apparel marketing campaign targeting active teenage boys.
example.zh: 這家體育用品公司推出了一場鎖定活躍青少年族群的運動服飾行銷宣傳。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 服飾銷售與公眾慈善常見客群名詞。

example.en: I am writing to inquire about your company's latest policy with regard to remote work arrangements.
example.zh: 我特此致函，就貴公司有關遠距工作安排的最新政策進行洽詢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益公文兩大王牌：with regard to (關於/就...而言)、Best regards (祝好/信末敬上)。

example.en: Our international charitable organization relies on corporate sponsorships to fund disaster relief.
example.zh: 我們的國際慈善組織仰賴企業贊助來籌措災難救助資金。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 非營利機構常客：non-profit organization (NPO, 非營利組織)。

example.en: We would be very happy to arrange a private demonstration of the software at your convenience.
example.zh: 在您方便之際，我們將非常樂意為您安排該軟體的專屬示範操作。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客氣商業書信常用：be happy to do something (樂意做某事)。

example.en: The project supervisor requested a couple of extra days to finalize the environmental report.
example.zh: 專案主管請求多給幾天額外時間以定稿環境評估報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 極高頻口語時間片語：a couple of days (幾天時間)。

example.en: Corporate management must act promptly to investigate employee reports of software piracy.
example.zh: 企業管理層必須迅速採取行動以調查員工回報的軟體盜版情事。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行動與代理職責：act as (擔任/充當)、act promptly (迅速行動)。

example.en: Our downtown showroom features a wide range of ergonomic office furniture and accessories.
example.zh: 我們的市中心展示門市陳列了各色各樣符合人體工學的辦公家具與配件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最愛考片語：a wide range of (種類繁多的/廣泛的)。

example.en: Our manufacturing plant is renowned for producing exceptionally high quality electronic components.
example.zh: 我們的製造廠以生產極高品質的電子零組件而享譽業界。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 品質保證核心字：quality control (品管/QC)、high quality (高品質)。

example.en: The senior project manager scheduled a weekly review meeting to monitor construction milestones.
example.zh: 資深專案經理安排了一次每週檢討會以監督工程里程碑。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 專案管理必備：project manager (專案經理)、manage a project (管理專案)。
roots: ject 丟 → 向前拋出的計畫

example.en: Business travelers booked round-trip airline tickets between New York and London.
example.zh: 商務旅客預訂了往返紐約與倫敦之間的來回機票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 機票與面試大考點：round-trip ticket (來回機票)、first round of interviews (第一輪面試)。

example.en: This international internship offers a valuable opportunity to gain professional experience.
example.zh: 這次國際實習提供了一個獲取專業實務經驗的寶貴機會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 求職與商務必背：job opportunity (工作機會)、equal opportunity (平等機會)。
roots: -unity 名詞 → 順風抵港的時機

example.en: The city transportation department announced scheduled road maintenance near the conference hall.
example.zh: 市交通局宣布了會展中心附近定時進行的道路維護施工。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商旅出差常用：on the road (出差奔波在途)。

example.en: According to the corporate travel policy, all lodging expenses must be approved in advance.
example.zh: 依據企業差旅管理辦法，所有住宿費用皆必須事先獲得核准。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀出題頻率最高片語：according to (根據/依據)。

example.en: Please check the attached price list for discounted corporate software license rates.
example.zh: 請查閱附件價目表以了解優惠的企業軟體授權費率。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業文具清單：price list (價目表)、waiting list (候補名單)。

example.en: If you wish to cancel or modify your conference registration, please notify us before Friday.
example.zh: 若您希望取消或更改研討會報名，請於週五前通知我們。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信客氣表達：if you wish to do something (如果您希望做某事)。

example.en: Severe storms delayed incoming component shipments; therefore, factory assembly was postponed.
example.zh: 強烈暴風雨延誤了零組件的進口運輸；因此，工廠組裝作業被迫延後。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 因果推論副詞，引出必然的結論或相應處置措施。

example.en: All factory visitors must wear hard hats and protective goggles inside the production facility.
example.zh: 所有工廠訪客在生產廠房內皆必須配戴安全帽與防護護目鏡。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益工安服儀規定：wear a badge (配戴識別證)、wear and tear (正常磨損)。

example.en: The corporate steering committee approved additional funds to expand our research laboratory.
example.zh: 企業指導委員會核准了額外資金以擴充我們的研發實驗室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 金融資助核心詞：raise funds (籌募資金)、mutual fund (共同基金)。

example.en: The team finished the initial design phase and will complete the rest of the project next month.
example.zh: 團隊完成了初期設計階段，將於下個月完成該專案的其餘部分。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 剩餘事務常用片語：the rest of (其餘的/剩下的)。

example.en: The family resort hotel provides dedicated recreational play areas for guests traveling with kids.
example.zh: 該家庭度假飯店為帶兒童出遊的旅客提供專門的休閒娛樂遊憩區。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 休閒飯店與親子方案常客：kids club (兒童俱樂部)。

example.en: Our corporation has established itself as an innovative leader in the renewable energy industry.
example.zh: 我們企業已建立起自身在再生能源產業中創新領航者的地位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 產業地位描述：industry leader (產業龍頭)、industry standard (業界標準)。

example.en: The corporate employee benefits policy includes tuition reimbursement for continuing education.
example.zh: 企業員工福利政策包含了在職進修教育的學費補助報銷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 在職進修考點：continuing education (進修教育)、higher education (高等教育)。

example.en: Factory management implemented strict security measures to prevent unauthorized data access.
example.zh: 工廠管理層落實了嚴格的安全措施以防範未經授權的資料存取。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 落實措施搭配：take measures (採取措施)、preventive measure (預防措施)。

example.en: The executive committee decided to kill the unprofitable project due to rising supply expenses.
example.zh: 執行委員會因供應成本攀升而決定終止這項不賺錢的專案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商務口語常考：kill a project / kill a deal (終止專案/取消交易)。

example.en: The hotel restaurant will serve a complimentary continental breakfast between six and nine.
example.zh: 飯店餐廳將在六點至九點之間供應免費的歐陸式早餐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 餐廳供餐與任職：serve breakfast (供應早餐)、serve as manager (擔任經理)。

example.en: The proposed corporate tax reform is likely to impact second quarter capital investments.
example.zh: 擬議的企業稅改法案很有可能會對第二季度的資本投資產生影響。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益極高頻句型：be likely to + 原形動詞 (很有可能做某事)。

example.en: Our support department will certainly investigate your billing inquiry without any delay.
example.zh: 我們的支援部門必定會毫不延誤地深入調查您的帳單問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 肯定承諾回應詞：Certainly, I can help you with that。

example.en: Our logistics network provides fast and reliable national delivery across the contiguous states.
example.zh: 我們的物流網絡在全美相鄰各州提供迅速且可靠的全國貨物配送服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 全國性範圍：national holiday (國定假日)、national conference (全國年會)。

example.en: The automated software updates itself every Sunday evening during off-peak network hours.
example.zh: 該自動化軟體每週日傍晚離峰時段會自我進行自動更新。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 事物本身反身代名詞：in itself (本身而言)。

example.en: Experienced systems engineers will teach newly recruited developers how to utilize the internal framework.
example.zh: 資深系統工程師將指導新進開發者如何使用內部開發架構。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 內部培訓動作動詞：teach someone how to do something。

example.en: The applicant possesses over fifteen years of distinguished professional experience in the field of telecommunications.
example.zh: 該應徵者在電信領域擁有超過十五年傑出的專業資歷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 專業範疇與外勤：in the field of (在...領域)、field service (外勤維修服務)。

example.en: All passengers must pass through airport security checkpoints prior to boarding flights.
example.zh: 所有旅客在登機之前皆必須通過機場安全檢查關卡。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 安全設施大考點：security badge (識別證)、security checkpoint (安檢處)。

example.en: Corporate business packages include discounted air travel fares with our commercial airline partners.
example.zh: 企業商務套裝方案包含我們商業合作航空公司提供的折扣航空機票價格。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 航空與空調常用字：air freight (空運)、air conditioning (空調冷氣)。

example.en: Our marketing delegation will host a promotional booth at the upcoming international trade expo.
example.zh: 我們的行銷代表團將在即將舉行的國際貿易博覽會上設置宣傳攤位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商貿展覽必備：trade show / trade fair (商展)、free trade (自由貿易)。

example.en: Companies should implement robust cybersecurity protocols to reduce the risk of sensitive data breaches.
example.zh: 企業應實施穩健的網路安全協定以降低敏感資料外洩的風險。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業風險管理搭配：risk management (風險管理)、at risk (面臨風險)。

example.en: The corporate communications team issued a news release regarding the company merger today.
example.zh: 企業公關傳播團隊今日針對公司合併事宜發布了一份新聞稿。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 不可數名詞大考點：news release / press release (新聞稿)。

example.en: All electronic components manufactured in our plant meet international environmental safety standards.
example.zh: 我們工廠製造的所有電子組件皆符合國際環境安全標準。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 符合標準搭配動詞：meet standards (符合標準)、safety standard (安全標準)。

example.en: The accounting division keeps an accurate electronic record of all commercial transactions.
example.zh: 會計部門對所有商務交易皆保存有精確無誤的電子紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 動詞 /rɪˈkɔːrd/ 記錄；名詞 /ˈrɛkərd/ 檔案紀錄：track record (過往績效紀錄)。

example.en: Hotel guests who extend their stay by two days will receive complimentary spa vouchers.
example.zh: 延長住宿兩天的飯店房客將可獲得免費水療抵用券。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 旅館住宿與狀態維持：stay at a hotel (住飯店)、stay informed (保持知悉)。

example.en: The enterprise is expanding its engineering workforce to meet growing demand for cloud services.
example.zh: 該企業正在擴大其工程人力團隊，以滿足對雲端服務日益增長的需求。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場最常考複合字：workforce (勞動力/全體員工)、task force (特遣專案小組)。

example.en: The express airport shuttle makes a brief passenger pickup stop outside terminal two.
example.zh: 機場快捷接駁車會在第二航廈外做短暫的旅客上車停靠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通工具停靠：bus stop (公車站)；non-stop (直達的/不間斷的)。

example.en: The hiring committee interviewed several qualified candidates for the senior accounting position.
example.zh: 招募委員會面試了數名具備資歷的應徵者以填補資深會計職缺。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 修飾複數可數名詞：several times (好幾次)、several options (好幾個選項)。

example.en: Please ensure that all overhead office lights are switched off before locking up the building.
example.zh: 在鎖門離開大樓前，請確保所有辦公室頭頂照明皆已關閉。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務轉折短語：in light of (有鑑於...)；lightweight (輕量級的)。

example.en: Our software engineers worked diligently to develop a user-friendly mobile banking application.
example.zh: 我們的軟體工程師勤奮工作，以開發出一款操作簡便的手機網銀應用程式。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 研發核心動詞：develop a product (開發產品)、develop a plan (擬定計畫)。

example.en: Please remember to attach your itemized expense receipts when requesting travel reimbursement.
example.zh: 申請差旅費報銷時，請務必記得檢附逐項列記的支出收據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 叮嚀句型必備：remember to do (記得去做某事)。

example.en: The final contract negotiations took a bit longer than originally anticipated by management.
example.zh: 最終的合約談判比管理層原先預期的時間稍微久了一點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 副詞修飾片語：a bit (稍微/一點點)、bit by bit (循序漸進)。

example.en: Our new smartphone product line helped the enterprise expand its global market share.
example.zh: 我們的新智慧型手機產品線幫助企業擴大了其全球市場份額。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業金融大考點：market share (市占率)、shareholders (股東)。

example.en: The corporate expansion committee consulted an experienced real estate agency to locate new offices.
example.zh: 企業擴張委員會諮詢了一家經驗豐富的房地產經紀公司以尋找新辦公室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業核心考點：real estate (不動產/房地產)。

example.en: Our customer service representatives strive to answer incoming telephone calls within three rings.
example.zh: 我們的客戶服務代表力求在響鈴三聲內接聽進線電話。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室電話與客服關鍵動詞：answer the phone (接聽電話)。

example.en: Meeting participants are invited to sit around the central conference table.
example.zh: 邀請與會者圍繞中央會議桌就座。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議就座用語：sit at a desk (坐在辦公桌前)、be seated (就座)。

example.en: The chief financial officer presented the latest sales figures during the executive briefing.
example.zh: 財務長在主管簡報會議上報告了最新的銷售數據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財報最常考名詞：sales figures (銷售數字)、figure out (想出/弄明白)。

example.en: Candidates must submit a cover letter and an updated resume to be considered for the position.
example.zh: 應徵者必須提交求職信與更新的履歷表方能列入該職位的考量。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 求職與推薦必備：cover letter (求職信)、letter of recommendation (推薦信)。

example.en: The board of directors will decide whether to approve the international merger proposal tomorrow.
example.zh: 董事會將於明天決定是否核准該項跨國合併提案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 決策核心動詞：decide to do (決定做某事)、decide on (決定選擇)。
roots: cide 切 → 切斷猶豫、決定

example.zh: 精通第二外語對於應徵我們全球行銷職缺的求職者而言是一項顯著優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 履歷專長必填欄位：foreign language (外語)、body language (肢體語言)。

example.en: Please write a concise and clear subject line when emailing client project updates.
example.zh: 在透過電子郵件寄送客戶專案進度時，請填寫簡潔明瞭的主旨欄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 書信主旨與合約條件：subject line (郵件主旨)、subject to change (可能隨時變更)。
roots: ject 丟 → 丟在下面、受支配者

example.en: Corporate business executives traveling on flights over eight hours are eligible for business class.
example.zh: 搭乘飛行時間超過八小時航班的企業高階主管有資格搭乘商務艙。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 機票艙等考點：business class (商務艙)、first class (頭等艙)。

example.en: The enterprise invests heavily in professional employee development and technical training.
example.zh: 該企業大力投資於員工的專業發展與技術培訓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 科技與人事專有名詞：research and development (研發/R&D)。

example.en: Our newly renovated flagship hotel is centrally situated in the historic section of town.
example.zh: 我們新裝修的旗艦飯店位於該城鎮歷史區的中心地帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 市中心核心字：downtown (市中心)、out of town (出城/不在本地)。

example.en: The airport shuttle departs from terminal two every half hour throughout the day.
example.zh: 機場接駁車全天每半小時自第二航廈發車一班。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 時間與財報考點：half an hour (半小時)、first half of the year (上半年)。

example.en: The executive secretary distributed the official meeting minutes to all committee members.
example.zh: 執行秘書向所有委員會成員分發了正式的會議紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：單數是「分鐘」，複數 meeting minutes 則是「會議紀錄」！

example.en: The corporate catering service provided exquisite food and beverages for the banquet.
example.zh: 企業外燴服務為晚宴提供了精緻的餐飲美食與飲料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 活動餐飲詞彙：food and beverage (餐飲服務/F&B)、food court (美食街)。

example.en: Workshop attendees will enjoy a fifteen-minute coffee break before the afternoon session begins.
example.zh: 工作坊與會者將在下午會議開始前享受十五分鐘的咖啡茶歇時間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議中場休息：coffee break (茶歇)、take a break (休息一下)。

example.en: The supervisor gave clear and direct instructions on how to file travel reimbursement claims.
example.zh: 主管對於如何申報差旅費報銷提出了清楚而直接的指示。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 清晰度與物流通關：make it clear (說明清楚)、clear customs (通關)。

example.en: We look forward to exploring mutually beneficial business opportunities in the near future.
example.zh: 我們期盼在不久的將來共同探討互利共贏的商業商機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 書信客套結尾句：in the near future (在不久的將來)。

example.en: Invoices can be settled using either corporate credit cards or direct electronic wire transfers.
example.zh: 發票可以透過企業信用卡或直接電子電匯轉帳任一方式進行結清。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 二選一必考配對句型：either A or B (要麼A要麼B)。

example.en: The new regional warehouse facility became fully operational three months ago.
example.zh: 這座新的區域倉儲設施在三個月前已完全投入營運。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 過去式標誌時間副詞：three days ago (三天前)。

example.en: The parking garage charges four dollars per hour during standard business daytime hours.
example.zh: 該停車場在一般日間營業時段每小時收費四美元。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 計算單位與依據：per hour (每小時)、as per your request (依照您的要求)。

example.en: Despite severe economic market fluctuations, our net operating margins remained strong.
example.zh: 儘管面臨嚴峻的經濟市場波動，我們的營業淨利率依然維持強勁。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 狀態維持動詞：remain competitive (保持競爭力)、remain seated (請保持就坐)。

example.en: Ensuring workplace physical safety remains the top priority of factory plant management.
example.zh: 確保工作場所的人身安全始終是工廠廠房管理層的首要之務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 第一優先與高階管理：top priority (最高優先)、top management (高層管理)。

example.en: Our lightweight laptop was ranked among the top three models in terms of battery efficiency.
example.zh: 我們的輕量筆記型電腦在電池續航力效能方面名列前三名之列。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益文法三者以上群體比較：among + 複數名詞 (在...之中)。

example.en: The architectural firm worked diligently to win the commercial design bid for the airport.
example.zh: 該建築事務所勤奮耕耘以贏得機場的商業設計招標標案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 得標與獲獎常用：win a contract (贏得合約)、win an award (獲獎)。

example.en: The corporate brochure will be printed in full color on premium recycled glossy paper.
example.zh: 企業簡介手冊將在高級環保回收銅版紙上進行全彩印刷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 印刷與商品規格常用片語：in full color (全彩印刷)。

example.en: The office relocation project will involve close coordination between all department heads.
example.zh: 辦公室搬遷專案將涉及所有部門主管之間的密切協調。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 專案範疇與參與度動詞：be involved in (參與其中)。

example.en: You can reach our technical support desk by dialing the toll-free customer hotline.
example.zh: 您可以透過撥打免付費客戶專線聯絡到我們的技術支援台。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 通訊聯絡與達成協議：reach someone by phone (以電話聯絡某人)、reach an agreement (達成協議)。

example.en: Our digital marketing team launched an advertising campaign across multiple social media platforms.
example.zh: 我們的數位行銷團隊在多個社群媒體平台上推出了一場廣告宣傳活動。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 數位行銷極高頻詞：social media (社群媒體)、social event (社交聚會)。

example.en: Newly recruited software developers will undergo a mandatory three-month probationary period.
example.zh: 新進軟體開發人員將接受為期三個月的強制性試用期。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 試用期與保固期名詞：probationary period (試用期)、warranty period (保固期)。

example.en: Our courier logistics network operates distribution fulfillment centers across the country.
example.zh: 我們的快遞物流網路在全國各地營運多座配送履約中心。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 遍及全球與全國常見介系詞：across the country / across the globe。

example.en: Management commended employees for their outstanding contribution to corporate innovation.
example.zh: 管理階層對全體同仁在企業創新研發方面所做出的卓越貢獻深表嘉許。

reviewWords.mnemonic: contribute 的名詞形式；make a contribution to (對...做出貢獻)。

example.en: We sincerely appreciate your ongoing corporate patronage and support of our products.
example.zh: 我們由衷感謝您對本公司產品的持續愛護惠顧與大力支持。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + preti (價格、價值) + -ate ＝ 認可其價值 ＝ 感謝或資產升值。

example.en: The regional chapter of the international chamber of commerce convened its annual summit.
example.zh: 國際商會的該地區分會假本地召開了年度高峰代表大會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：專業組織地方分會 (local chapter) 或重組破產保護 (Chapter 11)。

example.en: All research engineering personnel must sign binding trade secret non-disclosure agreements.
example.zh: 所有研發工程技術人員均必須簽署具備法律約束力的營業秘密保密合約。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 營業機密法規必考搭配：trade secret (營業秘密)、keep secret (保密)。

example.en: Apparently, the shipment delay was caused by severe weather at the transshipment port.
example.zh: 顯然，這次的出貨延誤是由轉運港口遭遇惡劣天候所導致的。

reviewWords.mnemonic: apparent (顯而易見的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 據了解、顯然地。

example.en: The research engineering group patented a novel approach to rechargeable lithium battery manufacturing.
example.zh: 該研發工程團隊為一種新穎創新的可充電鋰電池製造技術申請了專利。

reviewWords.mnemonic: nov- (新) ＝ 創新獨特的 (novel idea / novel approach)。

example.en: Management and labor union leaders negotiated the terms of the new collective wage contract.
example.zh: 管理階層與工會代表共同協商了新一期集體薪資勞動合約的各項條款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: uni- (單一) + -on (名詞) ＝ 團結為一體 ＝ 勞工工會 (labor union)。

example.en: The startup tech firm is closely tracking its monthly cash burn rate to secure runway.
example.zh: 該科技新創公司正密切追蹤其每月的現金消耗率，以確保營運資金維持充足。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 新創財務核心術語：burn rate (資金消耗率)；burnout (職場過勞)。

example.en: Industry market analysts highlighted a growing consumer trend toward eco-friendly packaging.
example.zh: 產業市場分析師指出消費者對環保包裝呈現日益增長的市場趨勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業分析必備：market trend (市場趨勢)、upward trend (上升走勢)。

example.en: The company completed its initial public offering on the international stock exchange.
example.zh: 該公司在國際證券交易所順利完成了首次公開發行上市 (IPO)。

reviewWords.mnemonic: init- (開始) + -ial ＝ 最初的 (initial investment / IPO)；動詞指在合約上簡簽。

example.en: It is our absolute pleasure to introduce our international keynote speaker this morning.
example.zh: 今天上午我們感到無比榮幸能為各位介紹本場國際主題演講貴賓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務禮儀必備套話：It's a pleasure (很榮幸)；with pleasure (十分樂意)。

example.en: Employees are invited to drop workflow enhancement ideas into the suggestion box.
example.zh: 公司歡迎全體同仁將工作流程改進構想投入意見建議箱。

reviewWords.mnemonic: suggest (提議) + -ion (名詞尾) ；suggestion box (意見箱)。

example.en: Securing additional financing is critical to the timely completion of the infrastructure project.
example.zh: 獲得額外融資對於如期完成該項基礎建設計畫而言至關重要。

reviewWords.mnemonic: crit- (判斷、決定) + -ical ＝ 具決定性重大影響的 ＝ 關鍵重要的。

example.en: Market researchers gather quantitative survey feedback from prospective retail shoppers.
example.zh: 市場研究人員從潛在零售購物者那裡收集量化問卷回饋資料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 收集資料或集會：gather information (收集資訊)、gather data (收集數據)。

example.en: Our digital software subscribers are mostly small to mid-sized commercial enterprises.
example.zh: 我們數位軟體的訂閱用戶主要多半是中小型商業企業。

reviewWords.mnemonic: most (最多) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 主要地、大體上。

example.en: Our manufacturing corporate pledge includes using only recyclable, earth-friendly materials.
example.zh: 我們製造業的企業承諾包括僅使用可回收的環保友善愛地球材質。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業環保永續：earth-friendly (環保的)、on earth。

example.en: The luxury fashion apparel retailer opened a pop-up boutique store in the mall atrium.
example.zh: 這間精品時尚服飾零售商在購物中心中庭開設了一間快閃旗艦概念店。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 新零售行銷必考名詞：pop-up store / pop-up shop (快閃店)。

example.en: Reliable high-speed broadband internet is essential for productive remote office work.
example.zh: 穩定可靠的高速寬頻網路對於維持高效遠距辦公而言是不可或缺的。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ess- (存在) + -ent + -ial ＝ 關乎生存存在的 ＝ 不可或缺的 (essential to/for)。

example.en: The candidate expressed a strong desire to assume international marketing responsibilities.
example.zh: 該應徵者表達了想要承擔跨國行銷業務職責的強烈意願。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 意願與期盼：express a desire (表達意願)、desired outcome (預期成果)。

example.en: We are currently reviewing updated vendor quotes for the corporate office renovation.
example.zh: 我們目前正在審核各家廠商針對企業辦公室重新整修所提交的最新報價單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: current (當前的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 現在、現階段 (currently available)。

example.en: The high-tech manufacturing firm employs over two thousand skilled production technicians.
example.zh: 這家高科技製造公司在本地僱用了兩千多名熟練的產線技術人員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: em- (進入) + ploy (折疊、捲入) ＝ 延攬加入工作；名詞 employee (員工)。

example.en: The corporate management training program offers a clear path to executive promotion.
example.zh: 該企業儲備幹部培訓計畫為同仁晉升為高階主管提供了明確的職涯途徑。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資職涯發展常用：career path (職涯發展道路/升遷途徑)。

example.en: Cybersecurity compliance will be the main discussion topic at the quarterly board meeting.
example.zh: 網路安全合規標準將是本季度董事會會議上的主要討論主題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: top- (地方、位置) + -ic ＝ 會議中特定聚焦之處 ＝ 會議主題。

example.en: Guests can relax along the private beachfront or participate in guided water sports.
example.zh: 下榻貴賓可在專屬海灘邊悠閒放鬆，亦可參加專人指導的水上運動項目。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 度假勝地廣告常用：beachfront (海灘第一排)、beach resort (海濱度假村)。

example.en: The international trade symposium attracted business delegates from thirty-five countries.
example.zh: 這場國際商貿研討高峰會吸引了來自三十五個國家的企業商務代表參與。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + tract (拉、牽引) ＝ 拉攏過來 ＝ 吸引 (attract customers/investors)。

example.en: Our digital marketing team uses interactive social media contests to engage potential consumers.
example.zh: 我們的數位行銷團隊透過互動式社群媒體競賽來深度吸引並串連潛在消費者。

reviewWords.mnemonic: en- (進入) + gage (保證、約定) ＝ 深度投身參與 (engage in / engage customers)。

example.en: Our cloud computing infrastructure features powerful data analytics software capabilities.
example.zh: 我們的雲端運算基礎架構具備強大卓越的巨量數據分析軟體運算能力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: power (力量、能力) + -ful (充滿) ＝ 功能強大高效能的。

example.en: Fresh flower arrangements were placed on all conference reception desks this morning.
example.zh: 今天上午所有大會接待櫃檯上都擺放了新鮮優雅的鮮花盆栽花藝。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 宴會接待細節：flower arrangement (花藝佈置)、fresh flowers。

example.en: The corporate public relations division enacted an emergency crisis communication protocol.
example.zh: 企業公共關係部門隨即啟動了緊急危機處理公關溝通作業程序。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 危機處理核心：crisis management (危機管理)、financial crisis (金融危機)。
roots: cris- (crit-) 分辨、審查、決定性時刻

example.en: Clients are kindly requested to settle outstanding hotel room invoices upon checkout.
example.zh: 請各位貴賓在退房辦理離店手續時結清尚未支付的客房消費帳款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：settle an invoice / account (結清帳單) 或 settle a dispute (解決紛爭)。

example.en: The beachfront luxury resort offers complimentary scenic boat tours around the bay.
example.zh: 這間海濱奢華度假飯店提供免費的海灣專人導覽觀光遊船服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 出差差旅接駁：boat transfer (渡輪接駁)、boat tour (遊船觀光)。

example.en: Small business enterprises received direct financial aid from regional economic authorities.
example.zh: 小型企業獲得了該地區經濟主管機關發放的直接財政紓困補助金。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 急救與資助：financial aid (財務援助)、first aid (急救措施)。

example.en: Special discounted lodging rates are available for corporate travel groups of ten or more.
example.zh: 十人以上的企業差旅團體可享有專案住宿折扣優惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務差旅考點：group rate / group discount (團體優惠價)。

example.en: In case of severe weather emergencies, staff will be notified via our automated text alert system.
example.zh: 萬一發生惡劣天候緊急狀況，將透過自動簡訊警報系統通知全體員工。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益必考條件句型：in case of (萬一發生/在...情況下)。

example.en: The woman who gave the opening keynote speech serves as chief technology officer of the firm.
example.zh: 發表開幕主題演講的女士擔任該公司的技術長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益聽力短對話 Part 3 常見提問對象：What does the woman suggest?

example.en: The scheduled shuttle bus service departs from terminal one around every twenty minutes.
example.zh: 定時接駁巴士大約每二十分鐘自第一航廈發車一次。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 聽力表示大約時間或費用常客：around three o'clock (大約三點)。

example.en: Business travelers are strongly advised to book their flight tickets at least two weeks in advance.
example.zh: 強烈建議商務旅客至少提前兩週預訂機票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益極高頻動詞！book = reserve (預約訂位)：book a flight, book a room。

example.en: The resort hotel provides spacious connecting suites tailored for guests traveling with family.
example.zh: 該度假飯店提供專為攜眷出遊旅客設計的寬敞連通套房。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資福利與飯店套餐考點：family plan (家庭方案)、family leave (家庭照顧假)。

example.en: There seems to be an error in the final calculation of the shipping charges on this invoice.
example.zh: 這份發票上最終運費的計算似乎出現了一處錯誤。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信委婉提出問題的用語：There seems to be a problem。

example.en: Please let the front desk clerk know if you require an iron or extra towels in your room.
example.zh: 若您客房內需要熨斗或額外毛巾，請告知櫃檯接待人員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務郵件高頻客氣句型：Please let me know (請告知我)。
